cases.title: Verify presence of both Classic and Modern themes under theme preferences
cases.description: Navigate to the theme preferences section and verify that both Classic and Modern themes are listed as available options.

cases.title: Verify Classic Theme Visual Display
cases.description: Apply the Classic theme under preferences and verify that its visual appearance matches the reference image.

cases.title: Verify Modern Theme Visual Display
cases.description: Apply the Modern theme within preferences and verify that the user interface is displayed correctly matching the specified reference image.

cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences item exists under View menu
cases.description: Navigate to the View menu and verify that the 'Theme Preferences' item is available and correctly displayed.

cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences item missing or disabled abnormal path
cases.description: Navigate to the View menu and verify that appropriate error handling or state is observed if the 'Theme Preferences' item is missing or disabled.

cases.title: Verify Get New Themes under View menu
cases.description: Navigate to the View menu and verify that the 'Get New Themes' item is present and available.

cases.title: Verify Get New Themes absence or disabled state
cases.description: Check the View menu under abnormal conditions to ensure the 'Get New Themes' item is handled properly if missing or disabled.

cases.title: Verify Classic item under View menu
cases.description: Navigate to the View menu and verify that the 'Classic' item is present and available for selection.

cases.title: Verify absence or disabled state of Classic item under View menu
cases.description: Navigate to the View menu and verify the handling when the 'Classic' item is missing or disabled unexpectedly.

cases.title: Verify Modern item is available under View menu
cases.description: Navigate to the View menu and verify that the 'Modern' item is present and selectable.

cases.title: Verify Modern item absence or disabled state under View menu
cases.description: Verify abnormal behavior when the 'Modern' item is missing or disabled under the View menu.

opinions.feedback: The proposed cases introduce speculative negative test scenarios for items being missing or disabled under the View menu (G-005, G-007, G-009, G-011) which are not supported or required by the baseline requirements. Please remove these speculative negative cases and ensure cases focus directly on verifying the specified menu items and theme preferences.
confirmed_blockers: Speculative negative scenarios testing missing or disabled menu items (G-005, G-007, G-009, G-011) are not grounded in requirements R-178 through R-181.

analysis.analysis:
R-175: Normal path - verify both Classic and Modern themes are listed under theme preferences. Boundary - exactly two themes. Abnormal path - missing theme option.
R-176: Normal path - apply Classic theme and verify visual match with reference image. Ambiguity - specific visual reference image not provided.
R-177: Normal path - apply Modern theme and verify visual match with reference image. Ambiguity - specific visual reference image not provided.
R-178: Normal path - navigate to View menu and verify presence of 'Theme Preferences'. Abnormal path - item missing or disabled.
R-179: Normal path - navigate to View menu and verify presence of 'Get New Themes'. Abnormal path - item missing or disabled.
R-180: Normal path - navigate to View menu and verify presence of 'Classic' item. Abnormal path - item missing or disabled.
R-181: Normal path - navigate to View menu and verify presence of 'Modern' item. Abnormal path - item missing or disabled.
